beats.label: S1 · Uploaded
beats.text: Programmer Nathan Brown dies in a suspicious self-driving car crash; girlfriend Ingrid uploads him to Lakeview, the luxury digital afterlife her family pays for.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the entire premise and the two forces — Ingrid's ownership of him, and the crash itself — that everything else pivots on.

beats.label: S1 · Angel & missing memories
beats.text: His Horizen customer-service angel Nora becomes his closest confidant, and some of his memory files are quietly deleted from the system the day he arrives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the central relationship and the first sign someone is actively covering up what Nathan knew before he died.

beats.label: S1 · It was murder
beats.text: Cousin Fran discovers the car was tampered with; Nathan and Nora piece together that his freeware afterlife project 'Beyond' has made him a target of the industry.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the show from workplace comedy into a murder mystery, and names Beyond as the thing people are killing over.

beats.label: S1 · What Nathan forgot
beats.text: During the annual update, Nora keeps Nathan awake so his lost memories return. He remembers secretly selling Beyond's code to Ingrid's father behind Jamie's back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the Kannerman family owns Beyond and that Nathan is not the pure victim — the guilt colours everything he does after.

beats.label: S1 · The assassin
beats.text: The assailant who tried to destroy Nathan's clone drive breaks into Nora's apartment; Nathan traps him in an elevator and kills him remotely with a stolen dev tool.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms someone in the real world will kill to bury Beyond, and forces Nora to run — the reason S2 opens with her off-grid.

beats.label: S1 · Nora goes off-grid
beats.text: On her father's advice Nora flees Brooklyn with her ex Byron, confessing her love to Nathan just as his data runs out and he goes silent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Separates the two leads and puts Nora into hiding, which is the exact posture she is in when S2 begins.

beats.label: S1 · Ingrid uploads
beats.text: Ingrid arrives at Nathan's room announcing she has uploaded herself to be with him forever; the lights go dark as his last gigabyte drains.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The closing image and the season's final trap on Nathan — she has locked herself into Lakeview alongside him with no exit.

cliffhanger.text: Nathan finally knows he was murdered and that he betrayed Jamie by selling Beyond to Ingrid's father, but he is trapped in Lakeview with Ingrid — who has just announced she has uploaded herself to be with him forever — while his data runs out and Nora vanishes off the grid to save her own life.
questions: Who ordered the hit on Nathan, and how deep into the afterlife industry does it go?
Where has Nora gone with Byron, and can Nathan reach her again?
Has Ingrid really uploaded herself, or is something else going on?

characters.name: Nathan Brown
characters.line: Uploaded programmer at Lakeview whose memories are now restored — he knows he was murdered and knows he betrayed his partner Jamie by selling Beyond to Ingrid's father.

characters.name: Nora
characters.line: Nathan's Horizen customer-service angel, in love with him and now on the run from Brooklyn with her ex Byron after the assassin came for her.

characters.name: Ingrid
characters.line: Nathan's controlling wealthy girlfriend, who tampered with his car to force the upload and claims in the finale to have uploaded herself into Lakeview to be with him forever.

characters.name: David Choak
characters.line: Nathan's ultra-wealthy Lakeview neighbour whose curiosity about the crash and open contempt for any freeware afterlife hint at deeper involvement.

characters.name: Ingrid's father
characters.line: The Kannerman patriarch who quietly bought a copy of Nathan's Beyond source before he died — the string tying Nathan's murder to the corporate afterlife industry.

characters.name: Luke
characters.line: A fellow Lakeview upload and Nathan's closest friend inside, one of the only people he tells the truth to.

characters.name: Aleesha
characters.line: Nora's steady fellow angel at the Horizen office, quietly aware of how far Nora has crossed the line with Nathan.

characters.name: Byron
characters.line: Nora's dating-app boyfriend, an alive man in Brooklyn; the person she flees off-grid with even as her heart is with Nathan.

characters.name: Nora's father
characters.line: Her devout Brooklyn father who visited Lakeview but chose not to upload; told Nora to disappear off the grid until they find whoever killed Nathan.

beats.label: S2 · Off-grid with the Ludds
beats.text: Nora's father hides her with the Ludds, techno-anarchist rebels; she is drawn to a Ludd named Matteo. Nathan gives up finding her and reluctantly returns to Ingrid.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Nora inside the anti-tech resistance for the first time and drops Nathan back into Ingrid's orbit — the two starting positions of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Ingrid never uploaded
beats.text: In truth Ingrid never uploaded — she visits Lakeview in a VR bodysuit. Nora glimpses them together via a cat avatar and assumes Nathan has moved on without her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret Ingrid is guarding all season and the misunderstanding that keeps Nathan and Nora apart in the first place.

beats.label: S2 · Nora inside Horizen
beats.text: Nora talks her way into a coder job at Horizen to sabotage Lakeview for the Ludds; the role finally lets her walk back into Lakeview and face Nathan again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the leads and gives Nora the technical access that drives every hack and reveal that follows.

beats.label: S2 · Choak did it
beats.text: Cracking Horizen's invasive new Mind Frisk program, Nathan and Nora find proof that his wealthy Lakeview neighbour David Choak was behind his death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the S1 murder mystery and names the real antagonist the second half of the season is chasing.

beats.label: S2 · Freeyond exposed
beats.text: A trip into Manhattan reveals Freeyond, the free upload service, is a swing-state voter-suppression scheme: uploading poor voters legally strips them of the vote.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Scales the conspiracy from a personal murder to a national plot, and gives Nora and Nathan a concrete target worth risking his life for.

beats.label: S2 · The clone body
beats.text: Ingrid confesses to Nathan she never uploaded and has secretly been growing him a clone body; free of guilt at last, he breaks up with her at once.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frees Nathan from Ingrid and puts a physical body on the table — the one thing that could get him out of Lakeview and into the Freeyond fight.

beats.label: S2 · Download
beats.text: Nathan downloads into the clone body to trigger his Freeyond backdoor; his nose bleeds mid-escape with Nora, while Tinsley restores his old Lakeview mind from backup.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Nathan in two and puts the clone body under the same failure sign that killed Rupert Tilford in S1 — the exact state S3 opens in.

cliffhanger.text: Nathan is on the run in the real world with Nora in a fragile clone body whose nose has started to bleed — the download-failure sign that killed Rupert Tilford live on TV. Back in Lakeview a backup Nathan wakes with no memory of anything since his upload, while Ingrid holds a hair from his brush and quietly plans to carry his child.
questions: Will the clone body survive the download or fail like Rupert Tilford's?
How can two Nathans co-exist — one on the run in a body, one restored in Lakeview?
Will Ingrid actually go through with her secret plan to have Nathan's baby?

characters.name: Nathan Brown (clone)
characters.line: Downloaded into a real clone body and on the run with Nora after triggering his Freeyond backdoor — but his nose has begun to bleed.

characters.name: Nathan Brown (backup)
characters.line: A restored earlier copy of Nathan's mind, woken in Lakeview by Tinsley with no memory of the download, the Ludds, or anything else the other Nathan just did.

characters.name: Nora
characters.line: Horizen coder infiltrated on behalf of the Ludds, back together with Nathan, and now fleeing with his clone body after they slept together on the Hyperloop.

characters.name: Ingrid
characters.line: Faked her upload with a VR bodysuit and secretly grew Nathan a clone body; broken up with, she has kept a hair from his brush and plans to have his baby.

characters.name: Matteo
characters.line: The Ludd who took Nora in when she went off-grid and became her love interest inside the anarchist camp.

characters.name: David Choak
characters.line: Confirmed as the man behind Nathan's death; the billionaire has downloaded into a robot body and is moving through the real world.

characters.name: Tinsley
characters.line: Aleesha's temp angel at Horizen, who — believing Nathan had been accidentally deleted — restored his backup mind into Lakeview.
